UNCOMMON / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Rarity / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A geometrical copyist preserves diagrams alongside their
arguments, keeping each letter faithful to its place. Exact
work lets another reader follow the same path, protecting a
proof from the smallest careless mark.
